scenarios.title: Water Order: Four Molecules
scenarios.explain: Eight H atoms and four O atoms appear on each side. Changing H2O to H2O2 changes the substance.
scenarios.predictionPrompt: Which element needs attention in the starting batch?
scenarios.explanationPrompt: Explain how your coefficients conserve one named element.
scenarios.keyIdea: Count each element separately. Coefficients change whole molecules; subscripts identify the substance.
hints: Keep every formula fixed. Compare the left and right counts of each element.
Change whole-particle coefficients, then recount the element rows. All rows must agree.
scenarios.teacherReasoning: Eight H and four O atoms occur on both sides; the simplest ratio is 2:1:2.
